title: Cochain counit equation for the explicitly transported scalar tensorator
statement: For commutative rings A and B in Type (u+1), a ring homomorphism phi:A→B, a scheme T in universe u, and cochain complexes C,D of fixed A-module sheaves on its pro-etale site, the explicit structure [def-pur-finite-scalar-monoidal-model] satisfies the full binary representative square [def-pur-finite-tensor-comparison-equations], using the actual fixed scalar adjoint, the actual adjoint-transpose representatives [def-sp-coefficient-scalar-representatives] and the native scalar-first cochain comparison [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data]. This is a concrete equation for an already constructed tensorator, with no existence or uniqueness assertion and no K-flat restriction.

source.place: Step 2: finite reduction is derived scalar tensor and its compatibility with invertible twists follows from derived tensor associativity; Stacks Tags 07A4 and 0FPT.

proof.text: Start from the native leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_tensorHom square on homotopy objects. Apply the cochain-to-homotopy quotient monoidal structure and quotientCompQhIso to express it on arbitrary cochain complexes. The mapDerivedCategoryFactors of exact restriction identifies the localized ordinary unit with the derived adjunction unit. Hence the prescribed homEquiv.symm representative is the native cochain counit preceded by the inverse leftAdjointUniq comparison. Substitute this identity in all three representative components. The coreMonoidalTransport formula cancels the comparison on the tensor source and the two factors on the target, leaving the displayed equation. These are equality calculations on natural transformations, so they require neither K-flatness nor flatness of phi. Identity maps, zero rings and the empty site obey the same identities.

proof_origin: J2, 2026-10-26: isolate the explicit native monoidal model and its remaining counit equation from existsUnique_finiteTensorCore. Generic construction, cancellation and uniqueness are proved in Lean. The equation is now projected from the actual typed diagram, definitionally the same source and tail composites.

theorem finiteScalarMonoidalModel_representative
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (C D : CochainComplex (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ) :
    (finiteScalarTensorData φ T).source C D =
      ((finiteScalarMonoidalModel φ T).μIso
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj D)).inv ≫
          (finiteScalarTensorData φ T).tail C D
